body.statement: In the special case \(d=1\) and \(E=2\), \(\operatorname{rank}(C)=1\) implies \(A=\mathbb R\) and \(Q_A=0\), so the finite-breakout branch is empty and the legal source-swap pair reproduces the already-known simultaneous-noise nonidentification of Kivva et al., Theorem 3.6.
body.justification: This reduction checks that the new frontier collapses to the closest known result at the two-environment boundary.
body.gap: This is already known from Kivva et al., Theorem 3.6, and is included only as a fidelity reduction rather than a novelty claim.
body.consumer: It lets users interpret the new condition as a strict joint-environment rescue of the established two-environment obstruction.
